:layout: landing
:description: The PERFEC System is a distribution of modular music making software for the Circuit Playground Express.

The PERFEC System
=================

.. rst-class:: lead

    The PERFEC System + a class set of Adafruit Circuit Playground Express microcontrollers is...

..  grid:: 1 1 2 3
    :gutter: 2
    :padding: 0
    :class-row: surface

    ..  grid-item-card:: A music making toolkit

        Build a complete drum machine.

    ..  grid-item-card:: A project ecosystem for high school CS/IT classes.

        An open ended source of managable projects at many levels of complexity.

    ..  grid-item-card:: A great platform for MIDI utility applications.

        Need a standalone USB-MIDI clock? Want to add some functionality to an old controller? 

    ..  grid-item-card:: An open source software distribution.

        A curated collection of open source music and synthesis code, customized to work together.

    ..  grid-item-card:: Pushing the limits of CircuitPython on CPX.

        Writing for efficiency with a resource constrained combo.

    ..  grid-item-card:: Making the most of what you've already got.

        There's a pretty good chance you've already got most of what you need in a closet in your school or Makerspace.
